{{short description|American mathematician}}
{{primarysources|date=December 2016}}
'''Peter D. Hislop''' is an American mathematician, formerly the Ralph E. and Norma L. Edwards Research Professor<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.uky.edu/CouncilEPC/endowed.php |title=Endowed Chairs |publisher=uky.edu |accessdate=November 26, 2016 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20161014101842/https://www.uky.edu/CouncilEPC/endowed.php |archivedate=October 14, 2016 }}</ref> (2010 and 2013) and University Research Professor (2004–2005), at the [[University of Kentucky]],<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://math.as.uky.edu/users/pdhisl2 |title=Peter D. Hislop |publisher=uky.edu |accessdate=November 26, 2016}}</ref> and also a published author.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.worldcat.org/identities/lccn-n88163545/ |title=Hislop, Peter D. |publisher=worldcat.org |accessdate=November 26, 2016}}</ref>
